title: KAESHI: a 2D beat 'em up with Sekiro-style parrying, free demo soon
author: Successful-Rooster53
selftext:
Hi r/aigamedev! I've been working on KAESHI, a 2D side-scrolling action game where you parry enemy combos hit by hit, break their posture, and finish them. There's no guard button, and elite swordsmen and bosses can parry you back, so it plays more like a duel than a button masher.



All the art and animation were made with AI. The part that took the most work was animation. Every move started as a short AI video clip, which I turned into frame-by-frame sprites. The hard part wasn't getting good motion, it was keeping the character looking the same across dozens of clips and making attacks readable in the middle of a fight. I ended up rerolling a lot and retiming frames by hand so slow wind-ups feel heavy and fast slashes feel sharp.



The story, combat rules, level design and boss patterns are mine, and AI handled most of the production around them. It let me make something much bigger than I could have otherwise, but it still needed a lot of picking and fixing to feel like one consistent game.



The free demo (Chapter 1, two boss fights) is coming soon on Steam:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5349160/KAESHI/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5349160/KAESHI/)



Happy to talk about the workflow if anyone's curious!

comments.author: novokvest
comments.body: Good job on character animation! Kinda like 2D Stellar Blade and probably just as hard. Have you thought of multiple costumes for the heroine? The game is too quick for my taste, but I like good 2D AI art!

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: Thanks! 2D Stellar Blade is quite a compliment haha. Multiple costumes are something I'd love to add if I have enough time!

comments.author: Wooden_Plant7504
comments.body: This looks amazing. I am indeed curious about your detailed workflow if you are happy to share.

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: Thanks! I'm planning to share more about the development process and workflow soon.

comments.author: maplecaca
comments.body: it really looks good. My only criticism based on the trailer is the voice line after the stagger visual and enemies getting chopped in half is a bit annoying if she says it every time. I assume that players will be using this mechanic a lot. Aside from that it looks great !

replies.author: Pastulio814
replies.body: o w a r i d a

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: That's a good point. The execution mechanic is used pretty often, so I'll definitely keep the repetition in mind. Thanks for the feedback!

comments.author: TheCelestialBubble
comments.body: I think you need more frames broski. The transitions look, well, a bit awkward

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: Yeah, I agree. I've actually been adding more frames and polishing the transitions recently. Thanks for the feedback!

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: Absolutely. There's still a lot to polish. Thanks!

comments.author: AhriKyuubi

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: Nice! I'd love to see yours too. Good luck with your game!

replies.body: Fair point haha. What I meant is that enemies can parry and counter your attacks too. I'll think of a better way to phrase it!

replies.author: Radcroc
replies.body:
Ahhhh gotcha. That makes more sense lol.   
Looks legit though. It’s readable, ui isn’t slop, and sprites seem to flow well. Better than most I see on here.

comments.author: Perfect_Answer_4095
comments.body: Wishlisting your game when i go home

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: Looks good but the characters have that "ai style" that will turn most people off.

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body:
Yeah, I actually tried a bunch of prompts and different approaches to make it look less obviously AI-generated. But at some point I figured that if I’m going to use AI for the artwork anyway, I’d rather embrace it and go for an art style that I think looks good.

Your comment did make me think about it again though. For now, I think I’m going to focus more on making the actual gameplay feel good and fun.

comments.author: Daikooku
comments.body: Oh cool !! Je suis aussi entrain de dev un jeu dans le féodale mais en rogue like avec pour le moment un shinobi, une démo arrive bientôt ton jeux est très inspirant continue !!!

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
I'm cautiously interested. Wishlisted.

  
Using AI video generation and then pulling out usable frames really does seem to be the only viable method at this point of creating decent looking animations.

Huge shame, because it's so wasteful. x.x

replies.author: Successful-Rooster53
replies.body: Thanks for wishlisting! Yeah, that workflow has been surprisingly useful for getting motion ideas quickly. There’s still a lot of cleanup and manual adjustment involved, but it’s been working pretty well for this project.

comments.author: TwoForGames
comments.body: Game for my taste. Cangratilations and thanks.
